title: DHL Global Forwarding services to link with Alibaba.com’s Accio AI platform
summary:
DHL Group and Alibaba.com have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore how artificial intelligence can improve the end-to-end logistics experience for small and medium-size enterprises (SMEs) engaged in international trade. The agreement was announced during Alibaba.com’s CoCreate 2026 Conference in Los Angeles, California.

Under the MoU, the two companies intend to evaluate how AI-powered tools could support customers across their international trade journey, from sourcing and supplier discovery through to logistics quotation, booking and shipment execution.
